issues_surfaced: F9: Voltage-clamp protocol mismatch — capacitive transient at step onset dominates Brian2-vs-NEURON peak comparison without skip-initial-transient and prestep handling.
F10 (CRITICAL): Unit-conversion bug in initial EGL-19 eqs (extraneous 1e-3 factor produced 1000× too-small currents). Caught via SS comparison divergence; fixed by removing factor.
key_decisions: voltage_clamp_compare_v2 grew skip_initial_transient_ms and brian2_prestep_ms parameters to handle capacitive transient + match NEURON's prestep convention.
EGL-19 eqs use straight gbar × m × h × (v_mV - eca) for current density in mA/cm² (no 1e-3 factor — units work out via S × mV = mA conversion).
